structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Fishing for Oysters and Clams; Device Restrictions

law.catch_line: Dredging for oysters in James River; penalty
law.text: It shall be unlawful for any person to dredge for oysters in the James River during the open season for taking oysters from the public rocks and shoals. However, the Commission may grant a permit to applicants to dredge in specified areas. A violation of this section is a Class 6 felony.
